components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default button: paper fill, hairline border, contact shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(24,24,27,0.12); border-radius: 6px; background: #fcfcfb; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(24,24,27,0.04); color: #1d1e22; cursor: pointer; font: 550 13px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.12s, border-color 0.12s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f4f4f5; border-color: rgba(24,24,27,0.18); } .ds-btn:active { background: #ebebed; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #296d9a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #1d1e22; border-radius: 6px; background: #1d1e22; color: #fcfcfb; cursor: pointer; font: 550 13px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #000; background: #000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #296d9a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 24px ghost icon button; muted glyph, tint fill on hover. Icon-only: aria-label mandatory, no visible text.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="More actions" title="More"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 15 15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="3" cy="7.5" r="0.75" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="0.75" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="12" cy="7.5" r="0.75" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #62626a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: #e4e4e7; color: #1d1e22; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #296d9a; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 34px field, grey border, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #8b8b93; border-radius: 6px; background: #fcfcfb; color: #1d1e22; font: 400 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #3f3f46; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #296d9a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(41,109,154,0.22); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #62626a; }

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: 30px menu row with tint hover and inset blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 184px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(24,24,27,0.12); border-radius: 8px; background: #fcfcfb; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(24,24,27,0.06), 0 6px 20px rgba(24,24,27,0.1); } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: none; color: #1d1e22; cursor: pointer; font: 400 13.5px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: none; background: #f4f4f5; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #296d9a; } .ds-danger { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Tree Row
components.description: Sidebar note row: 6px rounded, tint hover, active state.
components.css: .ds-tree { background: #f4f4f5; padding: 8px; width: 240px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; margin: 0; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: #1d1e22; text-decoration: none; font: 400 14px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row:hover { background: #ececee; } .ds-row.ds-active { background: #e4e4e7; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Native dialog: hairline, 8px radius, modal shadow.
components.html: Rename note
components.css: .ds-modal { width: 440px; border: 1px solid rgba(24,24,27,0.12); border-radius: 8px; background: #fcfcfb; color: #1d1e22; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(24,24,27,0.06), 0 24px 64px rgba(24,24,27,0.18); } .ds-modal-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 12px 0 20px; } .ds-modal-head h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 16px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-modal-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 20px 20px; }

narrative.overview: Grim's interface is a sheet of paper with ink on it, in a room with other people writing. No decoration that isn't structure: near-white paper, near-black ink, hairlines instead of fills, one rationed accent. Native-app quality in a browser — whole pixels, platform fonts, no font-smoothing overrides.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink; neutral tints; hairlines instead of borders-as-decoration
Ink is the primary; blue only points (links, focus, selection, presence)
Whole-pixel layout; platform font first, then Inter
No explainer or hint text anywhere

rules.name: The Ink Accent Rule
rules.body: Ink is the primary. Blue never colors a button, badge, or field; it points (link, focus, selection, presence) and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears exactly once: the Delete-account button. Every other destructive action is a weight-600 ink item.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px lines, not background fills. Tint fills are state (hover, active, selection), never permanent layout.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No text-transform: uppercase anywhere; labels earn hierarchy with weight and size.

rules.name: The Whole-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Every note size, line height and padding is a whole pixel so web and Mac put each line in the same place.

rules.name: The Floating Rule
rules.body: Shadows only on elements that float above the page (menu, modal, toast, drawer) plus a contact hair under bordered buttons.

dos: Do route every new color through a token in app.css and the .mde block
Do keep text ≥ 4.5:1 and borders ≥ 3:1 against their actual surface
Do make hover-revealed controls always visible on hover: none devices
Do draw icons with currentColor SVG/CSS at 1.5px stroke and give icon-only buttons aria-labels
Do check any note-token change against docs/typography.md and the Mac app's theme.rs
donts: Don't put explainer, hint, or caption text in the UI — ever
Don't add a second red surface or color destructive menu items red
Don't use blue as decoration, background field, or button fill
Don't uppercase labels or introduce a second UI typeface
Don't add shadows to resting, non-floating elements
Don't invent spacing outside the 4/6/8/12/16/20 rhythm or a new radius step
